battles.label: Gym 1 Warden Tamsin
field_messages: Giant webs glisten between the ancient trees...
The Silkwood hums with chittering life!
The flames raced along the silk!
{1} blundered into a sticky web!
Embers smoulder in the silk... ({1} more)
The webs went up in flames! The Silkwood burned down to ash!
{1}'s {2} sprouted silk-threaded roots!

battles.label: Gym 2 Warden Dorian
field_messages: The curtain rises! The spotlight blazes over the stage!
The crowd roared for {1}!
{2} resonated through the theater!
{1}'s {2} cast a spotlight on it!

battles.label: Gym 3 Warden Marisol
field_messages: The battle is taking place on the open water!
The waves amplified the attack!
The water doused the flames...
The current raced across the water!
{1} was swept up by the current!
{1}'s {2} wrapped it in a veil of seawater!

battles.label: Gym 4 Warden Rook
field_messages: Neon circuitry hums beneath your feet!
The neon grid surged!
The grid flickers and sparks... ({1} more)
The grid shorted out! The neon lights went dark.
{1}'s {2} magnetized it above the grid!

battles.label: Gym 5 Warden Sahar
field_messages: Heat shimmers over the endless dunes...
The shifting sands surged!
The desert heat evaporated some of the water...
The sands swallowed the foe whole!
{1} got sand in its eyes!
{1}'s {2} encased it in hardened sand!

battles.label: Gym 6 Warden Corvin
field_messages: Toxic sludge bubbles underfoot... the air reeks of corrosion.
The mire nourished {1}.
The flames consumed the mire, leaving a blasted wasteland!
{1}'s {2} filled it with corrosive vigor!
Toxic slag bubbled up from the ground!
The blighted soil sapped the plant life...
The corroded spikes ate into {1}!

battles.label: Gym 7 Warden Brann
field_messages: Magma churns across the battlefield!
The magma roared!
The lava surged!
The magma brought the water to a boil!
{1} was scorched by the magma!
{1}'s {2} ignited, searing it with volcanic power!

battles.label: Gym 8 Warden Kaito
field_messages: The crowd roars as the fighters enter the pit!
The crowd rallied behind {1}!
{1}'s {2} fired it up to the roar of the crowd!

battles.label: Gym 9 Warden Juno
field_messages: Tiny buds dot the garden beds.
Sprouts pushed up through the soil!
The flames scorched the garden!
{1}'s {2} took root in the garden!
The garden burst into bloom!
The blooming garden empowered the attack!
{1} drank from the blooming garden.
The garden is in full flower!
The flowering garden empowered the attack!
The dry petals fed the flames!

battles.label: Gym 10 Warden Anja
field_messages: The battle is taking place on a frozen lake!
The frozen lake chilled the attack!
The lake ice groaned and cracked! ({1} more)
The ice gave way! The battle plunged into the freezing lake!
The cold sealed the cracks in the ice!
{1}'s {2} encased it in a skin of frost!
The waves amplified the attack!
The water doused the flames...
The current raced across the water!
Ice spreads across the water... ({1} more)

battles.label: Gym 11 Warden Odessa
field_messages: Gale-force winds howl across the airship deck!
The storm supercharged the attack!
The gale whipped {2} into a frenzy!
{1}'s {2} crackled with storm energy!

battles.label: Gym 12 Warden Ilsa
field_messages: The world dissolves into a sea of drifting thoughts...
The Mindscape amplified the thought!
{1}'s {2} flooded its mind with thoughts!

battles.label: Gym 13 Warden Bastian
field_messages: Prismatic crystals glitter all around!
The crystals resonated with the attack!
The crystals refracted the light into a dazzling beam!
The red crystals set the rock ablaze!
The green crystals wreathed the rock in vines!
The crystals are cracking! ({1} more)
{1}'s {2} grew a crystal shell around it!

battles.label: Gym 14 Warden Ysolde
field_messages: Candles gutter in the ruined nave... Restless spirits stir in the gloom.
The restless spirits howled!
Light streamed through the stained glass!
The flames burned with an eerie ghostfire!
{1} is at home among the restless dead.
The cathedral bell stirs... ({1} more)
{1}'s {2} let a wandering spirit possess it!

battles.label: Gym 15 Warden Magnus
field_messages: Gears grind and molten steel pours... The foundry roars to life!
The foundry's machinery roared!
The crucibles flared white-hot!
The factory gears ground together!
The factory's gears meshed with {1}'s!
The gantries groan and buckle... ({1} more)
{1}'s {2} oiled its joints like factory machinery!

battles.label: Gym 16 Warden Nyx
field_messages: The moon has gone dark over Underveil... Something moves in the shadows.
The darkness of the new moon deepened!
{2} pierced the darkness!
{1}'s glow lit up the darkness!
Light pierces the darkness... ({1} more)
{1}'s {2} sharpened its night vision!

battles.label: Gym 17 Warden Celestine
field_messages: Once upon a time, in a castle deep in the forest... the story begins!
The storybook's magic sparkled!
{1} charged in like a knight in shining armor!
{1} wielded {2} like a true knight!
The dragon breathed fire!
{1}'s {2} granted it a fairy godmother's blessing!

battles.label: Gym 18 Warden Sigrun
field_messages: Magma glows beneath a dragon's hoard... Ancient wyrms watch from the stone.
The ancient wyrms roared in answer!
The magma-lit den blazed!
Steam hisses from the cooling magma... ({1} more)
The wyrm statues' eyes begin to glow... ({1} more)
The den has awoken! Wyrmfire surges through the lair!
{1}'s {2} kindled dragonfire within it!
Wyrmfire engulfed the attack!
The wyrmfire melted the ice away...
{1} was scorched by the wyrmfire!

battles.label: Fisherman Andrew
field_messages: Blue silence presses in from every side... The battle is underwater!
The water's resistance slowed {1}'s attack!
{1} is struggling for air!
{1}'s {2} released a bubble of air around it!

battles.label: Hiker Ford
field_messages: Grey ash drifts over the cooled crust...
The ash smothered the flames...
{1} is choking on the ash!
{1}'s {2} cloaked it in ash!

battles.label: Echo of the Ghost Warden Morwen
field_messages: The world turns inside out... Type matchups are reversed!
The Reverse World answers {1}'s call!
{1} turned the foe's strength against it!
{1}'s {2} turned its world upside down!

battles.label: Hollow Keeper Thistle
field_messages: Reality frays at the edges... The Bleed is spreading!
The Bleed convulses... echoes of the {1} tear through the battlefield!
The Bleed warped {2} into something stronger!
{1}'s {2} drank from the Bleed!

battles.label: Hollow Keeper Teo
field_messages: Darkness fills the cavern. The crystals have gone black...
The darkness gave the attack teeth!
{1}'s {2} drank in the darkness!

battles.label: Meridian Director Sabine
field_messages: Jagged scrap and leaking chemicals litter the ground...
{1} was cut by jagged scrap!
{1}'s {2} bolted scrap armor onto it!

battles.label: Camper Liam
field_messages: The cave walls loom close... every sound echoes.
The cavern rumbled!
Loose rocks rained down on {1}!
{1}'s {2} shook stones loose from the ceiling!

battles.label: Black Belt Taro
field_messages: The wind howls across the mountain ridge!
Boulders tumbled down the mountainside!
{1}'s {2} caught the mountain wind!

battles.label: Champion Shelly
field_messages: A blizzard rages over the snowbound peak!
The bitter cold dulled the flames...
{1}'s {2} packed it in a shell of snow!

battles.label: Picnicker Susie
field_messages: Waves lap at the sandy shore...
{1}'s {2} buried it in cool, wet sand!

battles.label: Gym Leader Amaria
field_messages: A brilliant rainbow arcs over the battlefield!
The rainbow's light poured into the attack!
{1}'s {2} shimmered in every color!

battles.label: Meridian CEO Aurelian
field_messages: Poisoned slag and dead trees stretch to a jaundiced horizon...
{1}'s {2} drew power from the tainted ground!

battles.label: Sovereign Valen
field_messages: The eighteen Plates blaze in a ring above Crownhaven's arena!
{1}'s {2} refracted the light of the Plates!
